title: Finding Sine and Cosine from Tangent in Quadrant III
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Given that \tan x = 1/2 and x \in [\pi, 3\pi/2], find the exact values of \sin x and \cos x.

steps.title: Find Secant Squared Using the Pythagorean Identity
steps.explanation: Substitute tan x = 1/2 into 1 + tan^2 x = sec^2 x to get sec^2 x = 5/4.
steps.why: The identity 1 + tan^2 x = sec^2 x holds wherever cos x != 0.

steps.title: Determine Cosine in Quadrant III
steps.explanation: In Quadrant III, both cosine and secant are negative, so sec x = -sqrt(5)/2 and cos x = -2/sqrt(5).
steps.why: Points on the unit circle in the third quadrant have negative x-coordinates.

steps.title: Determine Sine Using Tangent and Cosine
steps.explanation: Multiply tan x = 1/2 by cos x = -2/sqrt(5) to obtain sin x = -1/sqrt(5).
steps.why: The product tan x * cos x equals sin x.
